name: UPS (UPS-MIB, RFC 1628)
_comment: Applies to every device; UPS-MIB simply returns nothing on anything that is not a UPS. Identity OIDs list the UPS-MIB source first and fall back to the base ENTITY-MIB one after a '|', so this never blanks a switch's details. Live battery state (charge, runtime, load) is deliberately not collected: GLPI's inventory schema has nowhere to put it, and it is monitoring data rather than inventory.
